# SC2005: skip-self-dependency-violation

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for skip self dependency violation. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Provide a public parent/imported binding, or remove @SkipSelf() when the local scope is intended. A request/job consumer may resolve its owning module's application provider as a parent.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2005` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2005
const TOKEN = new InjectionToken<string>("value");
@Injectable() class Consumer {
  constructor(@SkipSelf() @Inject(TOKEN) readonly value: string) {}
}
// The local application binding is skipped; no parent/imported binding exists.
@Module({ name: "child", providers: [{ provide: TOKEN, useValue: "local" }, Consumer] })
class ChildModule {}
```
